data: This is a simulated cloud AI response. In a real application, this would come from a remote AI service like Google Cloud AI, OpenAI API, or Firebase AI. The response demonstrates how your application could gracefully fallback to cloud processing when on-device AI is unavailable.
educational_note: This is a demonstration of the hybrid AI pattern. Chrome AI APIs actually run 100% on-device and don't require cloud fallback. This mock endpoint shows how you could architect resilient AI applications that gracefully handle service unavailability.
